title: Work view: applying display filters refetches the whole Work set instead of filtering the loaded set client-side
outcome: After the full Work set has loaded, changing or applying display filters filters and sorts the retained client-side set, preserving selection and scroll. Only an explicit Refresh, a project or source change, or a list-changed or generation recovery starts a new loading generation. Today (landed master 9c80a234, after w-270c4b1fa8bc), WorkPanel.tsx:74 keys WorkResults on `${submission}:${JSON.stringify(filters)}` and line 84 calls useWorkList(projectId, filters), so Apply filters remounts the results and re-reads every page.
acceptance: After the full Work set has loaded, changing or applying any display filter or sort (lifecycle, kind, label, search text, sort column, view) issues no new work-list read: the panel filters and sorts the retained set client-side, keeps the current selection while it stays visible, and keeps the scroll position.

A new loading generation starts only on explicit Refresh, a project or source change, or a list-changed or generation recovery. Component tests assert that the work-list read count is unchanged across filter and sort changes and increments once for each of those triggers.
While a load is still in progress, a filter change applies to the rows loaded so far without restarting or duplicating the load.
The full gate passes on the exact landed input.
